openFindings.problem: Trusted V3 finalizer failure from Actions run 35333103534 is NOT repaired by this candidate. The release job passed all product/privacy/cost gates, iOS export, release APK build and APK hashing (steps 1-6) and failed only at step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path'. The emulator step still uses a multi-line script: | block (set -euo pipefail; apk=$(find ...); adb install -r; npm run e2e:android) which reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 line-splits and executes per line via sh -c (dash); dash rejects 'set -euo pipefail' (exit 2) before the APK install/golden path runs. This is the same root cause as finalizer runs 35293489693, 35302658175 and 35315519533, documented as F2 in reports/director/RUN_35325991233.md and assigned to the trusted shell. The workflow on main and lab still contains the multi-line block; the trusted shell never applied the documented one-line fix. The candidate changes only package-lock.json and does not touch the workflow or the e2e scripts, so the failure persists.
openFindings.evidence: GitHub API /repos/Mickalive/chorescore-v3/actions/runs/35333103534/jobs: release job steps 1-6 conclusion=success, step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' conclusion=failure; reopen-on-failure job success. git show origin/main:.github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml still shows 'script: |' with 4 lines at the emulator step; same in lab checkout. candidate.patch contains only package-lock.json; diff -rq vs pristine shows src/, scripts/, __tests__/, app/, package.json identical. scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh exists (bash -n OK) but is not invoked by the workflow.
openFindings.requiredFix: Trusted shell (sole owner of .github/workflows/ per AGENTS.md): on main, replace the emulator step's multi-line script: | block with the single-line 'script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh', then re-run the trusted finalizer. The Builder-scoped single-shell wrapper already exists and is preserved; no product code change is needed.
